feed.provider: Frozen public minute candle feed; exact 8-symbol/72h subset of original feed

study.scope: Bounded diagnostic grid; one representative of every configured indication prefix family plus four explicit timeframe controls. All factory range/strategy kernels remain independently regression-tested; this is not a full parameter sweep.
study.gridChanges: One TP per range, endpoint SL ratios, no-trail and 0.5 trail; independent trailing-only; Low-Range step 3. Prespecified before scoring. PF/sample/Last-N thresholds unchanged.
study.instrumentation: Record causal validation checks without altering selection or execution. Variants already measured in baseline; disabled here to bound memory.

policy.qualification: 8 fixed symbols. Production-normalized thresholds, grids and sources are frozen below; study overrides must be disclosed in study metadata.
policy.scoring: Post-Base qualified engine execution; independently qualified exact Signal configs separately; combined funded account separately.
policy.directions: Both directions enabled; realized counts reported, never fabricated.
policy.evidence: Offline model only; no venue fills or live promotion.
